## About
Florida Cars Used Auto Parts sits on NW South River Drive in Medley. We specialize in late model vehicles, with Nissan as our specialty and Kia and Suzuki too.
We keep an extensive inventory of used parts, and our part search link can help you track down what you need before you call. Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 81 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used parts inventory: We keep an extensive inventory of used parts on hand.
- Nissan specialist: Nissan is our specialty, so bring us your Nissan questions.
- Late model Kia and Suzuki vehicles: Beyond Nissan, we specialize in late model Kia and Suzuki vehicles.
- Local delivery: One reviewer used our local delivery service and got their Nissan part without waiting on shipping.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, from early morning to mid-afternoon. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. Our parts come with a standard warranty.

Q: How can I find out if you have my part?
A: Use the part search link on our website, or give us a call.
